MAJORS: (1) in-place in text mode rewrites CRLF to LF on disk, even the identity -> owner Q5: inPlace and nullData derive -b; (2) addArg -i / -ni / -z / --expression / -f bypass the typed properties (a sink edits or truncates the file with rc 0, loses records, reorders the script) -> owner Q6: deny-list; (3) ${inst}_exprs is fillable as an out-name, so records become the next run's script -> TUTIL_OUT_SUFFIXES registry with the two guards, tsed appends _exprs; (4) TSed.edit '' could not be the identity -> edit uses addExpr; (5) the missing-file pin was wrong for each (a proc, rc 1, RESULT untouched) and first (rc 0 + record + lastRc 2, the consumer-stop contract) -> restated. MINOR/NIT: rc 4 stops processing at the operand (not partial like rc 2), a missing -f script is rc 4; the backupSuffix rule targeted harmless characters — `*` alone (no backup, silently) is now rc 2, `*` and `/` documented; a script's q1/q2/q4 looks like a sed error (debug wording says so) and -i + q/Q/-n truncates silently (README trap); sandbox also refuses s///w incl. /dev/stdout and does not guard -i; --debug prints to stdout (sinks refused); a callback's bare assignment writes the instance's properties (bare sandbox=0 disarms the default — README trap); tutil/docs/TUtil.md §4 stale tsed row; #n and a\ across chunks; -i on -; two sed binaries; S5/S9 fixture details; -i implies -s. Verified: the proc each override keeps rc, frame, __TPIPE_QUIET, D6, this, no per-record cost; the refusal leaves _lastRc -1 and the file intact; the sandbox is compile-time and total.

Owner: start tsed. GNU sed 4.9 measured under both bashes (byte-identical): each -e is compiled when read, so every option must precede the first -e (`-e 's/(/X/' -E` silently runs as BRE); `sed FILE` takes FILE as the script; rc 1 bad script, 2 missing input (partial output kept), 4 I/O, q/Q N any status; text mode strips CR, -b keeps it; -z NUL records; one stream across files unless -s; -i writes nothing to stdout, suffix attached; e/s///e/r/w/W execute or touch files, --sandbox refuses them. Owner decided four questions before the plan: sandbox on by default; both expr and addExpr; rc 1/2/4 with debug, q/Q status silent; inPlace + backupSuffix with run only.
